cohort: 120 term pregnant women with anemia admitted for caesarian section at Al-Elwiya Maternity Teaching Hospital in Baghdad
finding: The study found associations between maternal anemia severity and fetal head circumference and abdominal circumference, but no significant differences in gestational age among anemic pregnant women.
mod_finding: This study examines the association between maternal anemia and neonatal outcomes but does not focus on differences related to mode of delivery.
